Storefront and customer routes of the pages module. Send `Accept-Language` (or `X-Locale` from a browser) on every call; a customer route needs the session cookie.

## GET /v1/pages

List published CMS pages

Responses:

- `200`: no description.

## GET /v1/pages/{slug}

Get a published CMS page by slug

Parameters:

- `slug` in path (string, required).

Responses:

- `200`: no description.
